game: Phantasy Star Online Episode I & II Plus (USA)

implementation.scope: Only the local offline player's accuracy rolls. Ordinary enemy accuracy, player stats, targeting/range/hitboxes, invulnerability and special-effect resistance are unchanged.
implementation.warm_jit: Existing native game-thread dispatcher executes dcbst/sync/icbi/isync for both hook code and both patch sites.
implementation.default: always_hit=true; a saved false value restores the exact original instructions
implementation.dreamcast: Unsupported until an independent revision-specific hit-resolution patch is verified. No GameCube addresses or ATA substitute are applied.

native_test.emulator: Dolphin, separate process and private runtime
native_test.setup: A copied offline test state initializes the game. A private copied receiver has EVP=32767 and both actual native resolvers receive a zero accuracy multiplier, so an ordinary accuracy roll cannot succeed.

reconnect_native_test.setup: Remove only the private test emulator's dispatcher pointer after warming the accuracy routines, then call pso_rehook.recover with the saved preferences retrieved from the real local backend.

limits: These are native routine and recovery checks, not a claim to bypass attacks that never contact a target, invulnerability phases, or every weapon special-effect resistance. No online accuracy change is enabled.
